hero.title:
The platform that unifies all of your
gym's management and sales.
hero.subtitle: Stop jumping from tab to tab to cross-check data. Pulse centralizes your current system data and social contacts, delivering financial, commercial, and administrative control in a single screen.

carousel.label: Used by gym chains and independent studios across Brazil

product.title: A complete view of your gym, synced in one place.
product.description: Stop wasting time cross-checking information across different windows. Pulse connects the system your gym already uses with your support channels, centralizing everything into a single management view.

billing.label: synced to your CRM and networks

billing.title: System Integration
billing.description: Connect the platform you already use. See your gym's data integrated in one place, without switching systems.

collection.title: Sales Funnels
collection.description: Bring together contacts from WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook. Get a complete sales funnel integrated with your current member base.

retention.title: Lead Management
retention.description: Make your contacts visible and manageable. Track conversations and know exactly how many leads converted in clear dashboards.

payments.title: Centralized View
payments.description: Keep your current system running. Pulse syncs commercial and administrative information into a single panel.

potencialize.title:
Your system and social networks,
working together.
potencialize.description: Pulse pulls information from your current management system (like Next Fit, EVO, or Tecnofit) and combines it with contacts arriving via WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook. Everything becomes an integrated funnel so you can manage leads and conversions without leaving the screen.
potencialize.dashboardAlt: Pulse dashboard integrated with gym system

demo.title: Discover Pulse's impact on your management.
demo.description: Book 30 minutes and see our platform in action with your own data. No canned demos — just your real problems being solved.

benefits.noCard: No credit card and no commitment.
benefits.dashboards: Visual dashboards focused on revenue and retention.
benefits.integrations: Live integration with EVO, Next Fit, Tecnofit, and WhatsApp.
benefits.cashFlow: Uncover hidden opportunities in your cash flow.
